status: prospective bounded structural diagnostic; no result yet
hypothesis: Some native MLP units jointly implement a simpler computation through equal or opposing full affine readers; opposing readers and opposing writers may form a learned linear channel through nonlinear units.
known_identity: For real-arithmetic GELU variants, g(t)-g(-t)=t. This identity is supplied mathematical semantics, not learned discovery. Actual binary64 responses are measured.
native_scope: All units in all four MLP layers of the existing 4-layer language model; no manually selected layers, units, or semantic examples.

proposal_generation.inventory: Every unordered full affine reader pair, for signs +1 and -1; bias included. Geometry is a proposal heuristic only.
proposal_generation.orientation: Both directed replacements for every retained unordered pair.
proposal_generation.selection_data: Native weights only; neither training nor evaluation responses select geometry proposals.
proposal_generation.no_claim: Retaining 64 does not establish optimality over all pairs or all programs.

responses.replacement: Replace unit j preactivation by sign times preactivation i, retaining its native output writer; execute native GELU to measure its exact changed output on the same parent.
responses.linear_cancellation: For negative reader pairs, compare native pair output with w_i*z_i and the reversed orientation, requiring the writer relationship as well.
controls: Remove both units for the pair-linear hypothesis.
Report writer norms and writer cosine; do not infer useful structure merely from low output impact.
report: Training and fit-disjoint evaluation maximum vector error, native MLP RMS normalization, and worst-row witness.
Relation-to-removal error ratio, including explicit zero cases.
Complete retained candidate bank and full geometry distribution summary.

data.evaluation_scope: Previously examined project panel, disjoint from training rows; not untouched confirmation.

followup_condition: Only a relation competitive with simple removal warrants compilation and full-model native-edit evaluation; report outcomes without introducing a hidden error cutoff.
required_for_discovery_claim: A smaller serialized executable program, with actual compiled maps and residual computation counted.
Independent replay and autonomous output KL, including native parameter changes that preserve and break the proposed relation.
Evidence beyond weak/dead units and the architecture-wide GELU identity.
negative_scope: Failure rejects this bounded pair-relation proposal family; it does not reject more general reusable computation.
compute: One memory-leased CPU scan of small native matrices; no fitting campaign and no GPU reservation. Runtime and source hashes recorded.
